title: Glimpse of Japan | Group Tour Special
highlights: Experience Japan's rich cultural heritage by exploring iconic sites like Kyoto's Kinkaku-ji and Tokyo's Meiji Shrine.
Visit Todai-ji, home to one of the largest bronze Buddha statues in Japan, and get to know the rich cultural history that this iconic temple has to offer.
Experience Japan’s cultural heritage as you explore iconic sites like Kyoto’s Kinkaku-ji temple and Tokyo’s Meji Shrine.
Choosing this package is itself an experience of Japan's energy of vibrant streets & scenic views from the famous attractions.
inclusions: Transfer from Narita International Airport to Shinagawa Prince Hotel, Tokyo
2 nights stay in Tokyo with breakfast
1 night stay in Kyoto with breakfast
1 night stay in Osaka with breakfast
exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
know_before_you_go: ID proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of arrival.
All foreign nationals must share their passport and visa details at the time of arrival.
All international and domestic airfare, visa fees, airport tax, or any kind of insurance cover is not a part of the package.
Any personal expenses or items of personal nature will not be included in the package.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the resort will be charged at actuals.
The hotels are subject to their availability. In case they are not available, the travelers will be accommodated in a property of similar standard.
Please do not litter and keep the destination clean.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Leisure Time in Shinjuku District
days.desc: Welcome to Japan, "the Land of the Rising Sun!" Upon arrival at Narita International Airport, transfer to your hotel. After checking in, board the metro (tickets included) to the lively Shinjuku District. Experience the bustling streets and variety of shops in Shinjuku. Then, visit Shinjuku Gyoen, explore Golden Gai's vibrant bars, and discover various other attractions. Later, return to the hotel by metro (tickets included) for an overnight stay.

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, get ready to explore Tokyo. Start your tour at Zojoji Temple and experience the views of Tokyo Tower. Next, visit Shibuya Crossing, the world’s most crowded junction, and the Meiji Shrine, known for its impressive architecture. Travel along Omotesando Street, admire the view of the Imperial Palace and explore the Sensoji Temple in Asakusa. Stop by Nijubashi Bridge before heading to Akihabara, the “electric town.” After sightseeing, transfer back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Kyoto | Kyoto Sightseeing Tour | Leisure Time in Gion
days.desc: Check out of your hotel and board the Bullet Train (tickets included) from Tokyo to Kyoto. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel and embark on Kyoto sightseeing tour. Visit the stunning Fushimi Inari Shrine, the Imperial Palace, and Kinkakuji Temple, known as the "Golden Pavilion." Next, get transferred to Gion, famous for its geisha performers. Here, you can explore the Yosaka Shrine and Kenninji Temple. Later, return to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Transfer in Bullet Train (Shinkansen)
items.desc: 1 X Bullet Train (Shinkansen) will be Provided

days.title: Transfer to Osaka | En-route Visit Nara
days.desc: After checking out of your hotel, get transferred to Osaka. Make a stop at Nara to witness deers, who roam freely and live in their natural habitat. Next, visit Todaiji, housing a grand Buddha statue. Continue to Horyuji, the oldest Buddhist temple in Japan. Upon arriving in Osaka, check in at your hotel and enjoy your day at leisure. Later, transfer to the lively Dotonbori District, known for its vibrant nightlife. Return to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: Pack your bags filled with unforgettable memories and cherish every moment of your stay. Check out of your hotel in the morning and board your flight home. This concludes your remarkable journey through Japan.
